title: Pan-Seared Shirataki Skewers with Croatian Crust
description: A French-inspired dish featuring crispy shirataki skewers with a nourishing Croatian crust, perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together the Croatian paprika, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Cut the shirataki noodles into skewer-sized pieces and coat with the paprika mixture.
4. Drizzle the olive oil over the skewers and toss to coat.
5. Thread the skewers onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is crispy and golden brown.
7. Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
